people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Damascus
people.line: Ancient city, capital of Syria, important in biblical history.

people.name: Eliezer
people.line: Of Damascus, Abraham's servant and potential heir.

translations.web: Abram said, “Lord Yahweh, what will you give me, since I go childless, and he who will inherit my estate is Eliezer of Damascus?”
translations.bsb: But Abram replied, “O Lord GOD, what can You give me, since I remain childless, and the heir of my house is Eliezer of Damascus?”
translations.kjv: And Abram said, Lord GOD, what wilt thou give me, seeing I go childless, and the steward of my house is this Eliezer of Damascus?
translations.asv: And Abram said, O Lord Jehovah, what wilt thou give me, seeing I go childless, and he that shall be possessor of my house is Eliezer of Damascus?
